description: This file is a JavaScript module used for testing the build process of a plugin in the OpenClaw project. It sets up, loads, and validates a plugin, configures runtime environment, and performs assertions to verify the plugin's correct registration and functionality.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Overrides process.emitWarning to filter or suppress specific warnings related to 'DEP0040' and 'punycode'.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes plugin commands and deletes temporary directories created during the test process.
